A court will not enforce the general anti-assignment clause against the distributor’s assignment of the right to payment. Under the UCC and the Restatement (Second) of Contracts, a clause that only generally bars assignment of “the contract” or its terms does not reach a right to receive money unless it says so specifically, and commercial limits on assigning payment rights are often ineffective. B, C, and D misstate that rule.
CONFIDENCE: 88
